entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Do you see the one who belies the religion?
Then it is him who pushes away the orphan.
And does not encourage (others) to feed the needy.
So, destruction is for those performers of Salah.
Who are neglectful of their Salah.
And refuse to give (small) things of use when asked.
